info.title: API.SH: PlugShare
info.description: The PlugShare API from API.SH: public PlugShare data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Recent community activity around a point, newest first: check-ins, newly added locations and new photos, each with its time, the member's public display name, the check-in or photo, and the location. Pass `next_before` back as `before`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/plugshare-activity

parameters.name: latitude
parameters.description: Latitude of the point.

parameters.name: longitude
parameters.description: Longitude of the point.

parameters.name: radius_km
parameters.description: Radius in km (default 15, max 200).

parameters.name: types
parameters.description: Which activity to include, comma-separated: checkins, locations, photos (default all).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Items (1-50, default 20).

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Only activity before this time (ISO 8601), for the next page.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: PlugShare stations in a map area
get.description:
EV charging locations inside a map box (centre plus height and width in degrees), with every filter of the PlugShare map. Each location: id, name, link, address, coordinates, access, PlugScore, fast-charger flag, connector types, station counts (total, available, in use), coming-soon and repair flags, network logo, and each station's outlets (connector, kW, AC/DC, live status). Up to 125 locations per call, the ones the map shows for that box; zoom in (smaller spans) for dense areas. Home chargers shared by private people are never returned.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/plugshare-map

parameters.description: Latitude of the point.

parameters.name: longitude
parameters.description: Longitude of the point.

parameters.name: span_lat
parameters.description: Box height in degrees of latitude (default 0.1, max 5).

parameters.name: span_lng
parameters.description: Box width in degrees of longitude (default 0.1, max 5).

parameters.name: connectors
parameters.description: Connector type ids, comma-separated (from /plugshare/v1/filters, e.g. 13 = CCS1, 26 = NACS (Tesla), 2 = J-1772, 3 = CHAdeMO).

parameters.name: min_power
parameters.description: Minimum charging power in kW.

parameters.name: max_power
parameters.description: Maximum charging power in kW.

parameters.name: networks
parameters.description: Only these network ids, comma-separated (from /plugshare/v1/networks).

parameters.name: exclude_networks
parameters.description: Leave out these network ids, comma-separated.

parameters.name: min_stations
parameters.description: At least this many stations at the location.

parameters.name: free_only
parameters.description: Only locations that are free to use.

parameters.name: available_now
parameters.description: Only locations with a station reported available now.

parameters.name: min_plugscore
parameters.description: Minimum PlugScore (1-10).

parameters.name: amenities
parameters.description: Amenity ids, comma-separated (1 Lodging, 2 Dining, 3 Restrooms, 4 EV Parking, 5 Valet Parking, 6 Park, 7 WiFi, 8 Shopping, 9 Grocery, 10 Hiking, 11 Camping).

parameters.name: parking
parameters.description: Parking attribute ids, comma-separated (e.g. COVERED, GARAGE, PULL_IN, PULL_THROUGH; see /plugshare/v1/filters).

parameters.name: places
parameters.description: Only these place types, comma-separated (e.g. HOTEL, AIRPORT, GROCERY_STORE; see /plugshare/v1/filters).

parameters.name: exclude_places
parameters.description: Leave out these place types, comma-separated.

parameters.name: exclude_dealerships
parameters.description: Leave out car dealerships.

parameters.name: include_restricted
parameters.description: false: public locations only (default true: also locations restricted to customers, guests, residents...).

parameters.name: coming_soon
parameters.description: include (default), only, or exclude locations that are not open yet.

parameters.name: exclude_tesla_only
parameters.description: Leave out locations only Tesla drivers can use.

parameters.name: exclude_rivian_only
parameters.description: Leave out locations only Rivian drivers can use.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
